name: idealo-de-scraper
title: Idealo.de Price Comparison Scraper
description: Scrape product prices from Idealo.de, a German price comparison platform. Compare prices across thousands of merchants, extract product specs, ratings, and merchant offers. Supports DE, FR, ES, IT, UK.
readme:
# Idealo Scraper - Price Comparison Data

Get product prices, offer counts, ratings and specifications from [idealo](https://www.idealo.de), the price comparison site for Germany, France, Spain, Italy and the United Kingdom. Search by keyword or paste a category page, and receive one row per product, ready for price monitoring, market research and catalog enrichment.

## What you can do with it

- Search idealo by keyword and collect the best price, the number of offers, the rating and the product image for every hit.
- Scrape a whole product category from its idealo URL.
- Turn on product details to add the specification table, brand, category, EAN (for model variants) and the shop with the lowest item price (shipping not included).
- Switch between the five country sites. Currency follows the site (EUR, GBP for the UK).
- Cap the number of products and the spend per run.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `searchQuery` | string | `laptop` (prefill) | Product search term, for example `iphone 15` or `waschmaschine`. Used when `categoryUrl` is empty. If both are empty, `laptop` is searched. |
| `categoryUrl` | string | none | An idealo category URL. Takes priority over `searchQuery`. |
| `maxResults` | integer | `10` | Maximum products to return (1 to 1000). A number given as text, like `"10"`, is accepted. |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | `false` | Open every product page for specifications, brand, category, EAN and the shop with the lowest item price. `"true"` as text is accepted. |
| `country` | string | `de` | One of `de`, `fr`, `es`, `it`, `uk`. |

An empty input `{}` runs the default search with the defaults above.

### Example inputs

Search with prices only:

```json
{
  "searchQuery": "waschmaschine",
  "maxResults": 100,
  "includeDetails": false,
  "country": "de"
}
```

A category page with product details:

```json
{
  "categoryUrl": "https://www.idealo.de/preisvergleich/ProductCategory/3751.html",
  "maxResults": 50,
  "includeDetails": true
}
```

### Supported URLs

| Page | Example |
|------|---------|
| Category | `https://www.idealo.de/preisvergleich/ProductCategory/3751.html` |
| Search | use `searchQuery` instead of a URL |

Use the domain that matches the `country` you select (`idealo.fr`, `idealo.es`, `idealo.it`, `idealo.co.uk`).

## Output

One row per product. Fields marked "details only" are empty unless `includeDetails` is `true`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Product name |
| `product_url` | string | Product page on idealo |
| `product_image_url` | string | Product image |
| `description` | string | Short product summary (key specs in one line) |
| `best_price` | number | Lowest price listed on idealo, in `price_currency` |
| `price_currency` | string | `EUR`, or `GBP` for the UK |
| `price_count` | integer | Number of shop offers |
| `rating` | number | Average user rating, 0 to 5. Empty when the product has no rating |
| `review_count` | integer | Number of ratings. Empty when idealo does not show it |
| `brand` | string | Brand (details only) |
| `category` | string | Category path (details only) |
| `ean` | string | EAN/GTIN (details only). Filled for a specific model variant; empty for grouped product pages that cover several variants |
| `merchant_name` | string | Shop with the lowest item price, shipping not included (details only) |
| `merchant_price` | number | Price at that shop (details only) |
| `specs` | object | Specification table as key/value pairs, in the site language (details only) |
| `source_url` | string | The search or category URL the row came from |
| `source_platform` | string | `idealo.de`, `idealo.fr`, `idealo.es`, `idealo.it` or `idealo.uk` |
| `scraped_at` | string | ISO 8601 timestamp |

### Sample row

```json
{
  "product_image_url": "https://cdn.idealo.com/folder/Product/202616/3/202616394/s1_produktbild_mittelgross/lenovo-v15-g4.jpg",
  "name": "Lenovo V15 G4",
  "description": "Multimedia Notebook, 15,6 Zoll, Bildformat 16:9, Akkulaufzeit 8,4 h, 1,65 kg",
  "brand": "Lenovo",
  "category": "Elektroartikel > Computer > Notebooks",
  "best_price": 365.66,
  "price_currency": "EUR",
  "price_count": 518,
  "rating": 4.2,
  "review_count": 5,
  "ean": null,
  "product_url": "https://www.idealo.de/preisvergleich/OffersOfProduct/202616394_-v15-g4-lenovo.html",
  "merchant_name": "eBay",
  "merchant_price": 365.66,
  "specs": {
    "Displaygröße": "15,6 Zoll",
    "Gewicht": "1,65 kg",
    "Akkulaufzeit": "8,4 h"
  },
  "source_url": "https://www.idealo.de/preisvergleich/MainSearchProductCategory.html?q=laptop",
  "source_platform": "idealo.de",
  "scraped_at": "2026-10-26T06:48:03.709Z"
}
```

Without details, `brand`, `category`, `ean`, `merchant_name`, `merchant_price` and `specs` are `null`.

## Pricing

The actor uses pay-per-event pricing. Current prices are shown on the Pricing tab of the actor page.

| Event | When it is charged |
|-------|--------------------|
| `ecommerce-start` | Once per run, together with the first delivered product |
| `ecommerce-serp-result` | Per product delivered without details |
| `ecommerce-detail-result` | Per product delivered with details. It replaces the result event for that product, it is not added to it |

A product whose detail page could not be loaded is charged as a result without details. A run that finds nothing is not charged. Set a maximum total charge for the run and the actor stops delivering products when the next one would exceed it.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible client such as Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor or VS Code.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "apify": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "mcp-remote",
        "https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=santamaria-automations/idealo-de-scraper",
        "--header",
        "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_TOKEN>"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Example prompt: "Use `idealo-de-scraper` to find the 20 cheapest washing machines on idealo.de and return name, best price and number of offers as a table."

## FAQ

**How do I get a category URL?**
Open idealo, browse to a product category and copy the address from the browser. It looks like `https://www.idealo.de/preisvergleich/ProductCategory/3751.html`.

**Why are some products without a rating?**
idealo shows no rating for products nobody has rated yet. `rating` and `review_count` are then empty.

**Why is `ean` empty?**
Pages that group several model variants (for example one phone in all colors) carry no single EAN. Search for the exact variant to get its EAN.

**Why does a product show fewer offers with details than in the list?**
The list and the product page are read at different moments, and the product page counts the offers for that exact product. Offer counts change during the day.

**Why did my search return nothing?**
idealo reported no hits for the search term. Try a more general term. The run ends successfully and nothing is charged.

**How do I stop at a budget?**
Set a maximum total charge for the run in the run options. The actor stops after the last product that fits and reports "Stopped at the max charge limit. N products delivered."

**How many products can I get per search?**
Up to 1000 per run. idealo shows about 35 products per result page. The actor continues through the pages until `maxResults` is reached or the results end.
